$comment: Single source of truth for the network this app targets AND deploys to. Change `active` to retarget everything: the app's runtime backends/contracts (via src/lib/polkadot/constants.ts) AND the `pad` deploy env (via scripts/deploy.mjs + polkadot-app-deploy.config.ts, which pass `--env <active>`). Each network's key equals its `pad`/`dotns` --env id. `domain` is the app's own .dot name (network-independent). `chain` is the Product SDK preset passed to getChainAPI — it, NOT `assetHubRpc`, decides which chain the app actually connects to, so it must name a real SDK Environment (`paseo` | `devnet`). A network the SDK has no preset for cannot be targeted: the app would connect to the preset's chain while using this entry's contract addresses, and every contract read would fail. Values are a subset of polkadot-app-deploy/assets/environments.json (the source of truth); re-sync from there when backends change.
